claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item can change its own form as an activation, but activation phases currently cannot attach to or target the item itself. `alter_item_kind` exists, but the authored surface has no item/object attachment variant to apply it honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding this weapon, you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod ... or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.item_form
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Several mechanics are conditional on the current form of the same held item. The current equipment predicate grammar can say holding/wearing/wielding, but not 'holding this item while it is in quarterstaff form' or 'quarterstaff and 10-foot pole forms only'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only). ... Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_weapon_profile
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface can filter by existing weapon property or specific item, but it cannot grant a new weapon property/range profile to a specific form of an item. This rider changes the weapon's usable attack profile rather than dealing damage or granting a passive numeric bonus.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Ranged Weapon (Quarterstaff Form Only). This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: return_weapon_after_ranged_attack
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The quarterstaff's automatic return to hand after a ranged attack is a deterministic combat mechanic, but there is no current atom for a weapon returning to the wielder after an attack resolves.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand.
